SELECT 
    c_last_name, 
    c_first_name, 
    c_salutation, 
    c_preferred_cust_flag, 
    ss_ticket_number, 
    cnt 
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        ss_ticket_number, 
        ss_customer_sk, 
        COUNT(*) AS cnt 
     FROM 
        store_sales 
     JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            d_date_sk 
         FROM 
            date_dim 
         WHERE 
            d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2 
            AND d_year IN (2000, 2001, 2002)) AS dd_filtered 
     ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = dd_filtered.d_date_sk 
     JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            s_store_sk 
         FROM 
            store 
         WHERE 
            s_county IN ('Williamson County')) AS store_filtered 
     ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store_filtered.s_store_sk 
     JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            hd_demo_sk 
         FROM 
            household_demographics 
         WHERE 
            (hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' OR hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000') 
            AND hd_vehicle_count > 0 
            AND hd_dep_count > hd_vehicle_count) AS hd_filtered 
     ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_filtered.hd_demo_sk 
     GROUP BY 
        ss_ticket_number, 
        ss_customer_sk) AS dj 
JOIN 
    customer 
ON 
    dj.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk 
WHERE 
    cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5 
ORDER BY 
    cnt DESC, 
    c_last_name ASC
